Extreme close-up cropping that emphasizes the eyes and nose as central focal points
Text-to-image layering where typography appears to float in front of the facial features

coreInvariants: 3D beveled effect on all typographic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face occupies 100% of the frame, cropped tightly around the eyes, nose, and mouth.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The left eye and the bridge of the nose serve as the primary visual anchors.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top bold text, moves down the bridge of the nose to the mouth, and finishes at the bottom right text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with the subject, using deep shadows as functional negative space.
